header_copy.title: Knowledge Flush — Review before confirm
header_copy.subtitle: This dialog only marks a draft as eligible for an approved live flush. It does NOT write to the Hermes knowledge base.

body_copy.step_intro: Step 2 of 3 — Review the gates. Each gate must pass before the Confirm button can be enabled.

gate_cards.copy: You have explicitly said "我授权 flush" in this session. Confirmation only marks the draft as eligible — it does NOT write.
Source fidelity failed. A source is mis-labeled, or fetched_at has drifted. The live flush will be rejected.
local_known, newly_found, and judgment are split according to source_type.
The target is not a locked roadmap. The draft cannot modify any locked-roadmap file.

risk_cards.copy: source_type="vault" is reserved for vault:// URIs. Using a local filesystem path labeled "vault" to claim trusted instruction authority is rejected at the source-fidelity gate (HARD FAIL).
Approving this dialog only marks the draft as pending_live_flush. The real knowledgeIngest call requires Slice 008 approval and a user-acceptance test with a real flush.

confirm_button.label: Confirm Flush
confirm_button.disabled_reason: Confirm Flush is disabled because one or more gates failed. Resolve the failing gate and re-open the dialog.

terminal_copy.title: Draft blocked by validation
terminal_copy.body: This draft cannot be confirmed because one or more gates failed. The live flush will be rejected even if the user says "我授权 flush".
terminal_copy.next_step: Next step: edit and review the draft (remove secret-like fields, fix source fidelity issues, correct bucket semantics) and re-open the dialog. Do not try to bypass the gates.

safety_footer_copy: runtime_flush_allowed = false · live adapter not approved · confirmation only makes the draft eligible for an approved flush path
